# The package a sql: import writes for MySQL, run against the harness's
# server (internal/testsql: MariaDB or MySQL, whichever is on PATH) on the
# interpreter and each Go platform; android reaches SQLite alone. Each test opens a database of its own, which
# `sqlserver` empties before every target's run. A launch answered from its
# record reaches no server, so CI, which has none, replays those alone.

[mysql] sqlserver mysql roundtrip nulls missing many exec constraint
[mysql] sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
[mysql] stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

[mysql] sqlserver mysql roundtrip nulls missing many exec constraint
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

[mysql] sqlserver mysql roundtrip nulls missing many exec constraint
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

[mysql] sqlserver mysql roundtrip nulls missing many exec constraint
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
// Every MySQL type the import reads written and read back, a failure
// classified by its SQLSTATE, and the id AUTO_INCREMENT gave.

import async "sngl:async"
import books "sql:./db/queries.sql"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const server = "root@tcp(127.0.0.1:47831)/"

func add(title string, shelf books.BooksShelf = books.BooksShelf.fiction) int64 {
    match var id = books.addBookCall(title=title, pages=null, price="0", rating=0.0, lent=false, shelf=shelf, added=null, due=null) {
        ok { return id }
        failed { return -1 }
    }
}

func testRoundTrip(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "roundtrip")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 1)
    match var id = books.addBookCall(title="Earthsea", pages=264, price="12.50", rating=4.5, lent=true, shelf=books.BooksShelf.nonFiction, added="2024-03-01T10:30:00Z", due="2024-04-01") {
        ok { t.assert(id == 1) }
        failed { t.assert(id.message == "") }
    }
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=1) {
        ok {
            if b == null {
                t.assert(false)
            } else {
                t.assert(b.title == "Earthsea")
                t.assert(b.pages == 264)
                t.assert(b.price == "12.50")
                t.assert(b.rating == 4.5)
                t.assert(b.lent)
                t.assert(b.shelf == books.BooksShelf.nonFiction)
                t.assert(b.added != null && "{b.added}" == "2024-03-01T10:30:00Z")
                t.assert(b.due != null && "{b.due}" == "2024-04-01")
            }
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testNulls(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "nulls")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 1)
    var id = add("Tehanu")
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=id) {
        ok {
            if b == null {
                t.assert(false)
            } else {
                t.assert(b.pages == null)
                t.assert(b.added == null)
                t.assert(b.due == null)
                t.assert(!b.lent)
            }
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testMissing(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "missing")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 1)
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=99) {
        ok { t.assert(b == null) }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testMany(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "many")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 1)
    add("The Farthest Shore")
    add("A Wizard of Earthsea", books.BooksShelf.poetry)
    add("Tales", books.BooksShelf.poetry)
    match var found = books.onShelfCall(shelf=books.BooksShelf.poetry) {
        ok {
            t.assert(found.length() == 2)
            t.assert(found[0].title == "A Wizard of Earthsea")
        }
        failed { t.assert(found.message == "") }
    }
    match var n = books.countBooksCall() {
        ok { t.assert(n == 3) }
        failed { t.assert(n.message == "") }
    }
}

func testExec(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "exec")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 1)
    var id = add("Tehanu")
    t.assert(books.lendBookCall(lent=true, id=id).ok == 1)
    t.assert(books.lendBookCall(lent=true, id=99).ok == 0)
    match var done = books.removeBookCall(id=id) {
        ok { t.assert(done.rows == 1) }
        failed { t.assert(done.message == "") }
    }
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=id) {
        ok { t.assert(b == null) }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

// A duplicate key is SQLSTATE 23000, which a retry fails alike.
func testConstraint(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, server + "constraint")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 1)
    add("Tehanu")
    match var id = books.addBookCall(title="Tehanu", pages=null, price="0", rating=0.0, lent=false, shelf=books.BooksShelf.fiction, added=null, due=null) {
        ok { t.assert(false) }
        failed {
            t.assert(id.kind == async.FailureKind.request)
            t.assert(id.code == "23000")
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="books")
}
-- db/schema.sql --
-- sngl:engine mysql

CREATE TABLE books (
  id     bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  title  varchar(200) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  pages  int,
  price  decimal(8, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  rating double NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  lent   tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  shelf  enum('fiction', 'non-fiction', 'poetry') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fiction',
  added  datetime,
  due    date
);
-- db/queries.sql --
-- sngl:schema schema.sql

-- name: AddBook :execlastid
INSERT INTO books (title, pages, price, rating, lent, shelf, added, due)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);

-- name: GetBook :one
SELECT * FROM books WHERE id = ?;

-- name: OnShelf :many
SELECT id, title FROM books WHERE shelf = ? ORDER BY id;

-- name: CountBooks :one
SELECT count(*) FROM books;

-- name: LendBook :execrows
UPDATE books SET lent = ? WHERE id = ?;

-- name: RemoveBook :exec
DELETE FROM books WHERE id = ?;
